pr_body:
Lucene 9.9 has introduced a new posting format that uses FOR instead of PFOR. Elasticsearch prefers the  former format, therefore we introduce it as a our own posting format here.

fixes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/103002
pr_title: Introduce Elasticsearch PostingFormat based on Lucene 90 positing format using PFOR
pr_comment: Hi @iverase, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

A question about the 1st comment "Lucene 9.9 has introduced a new posting format that uses FOR instead of PFOR. Elasticsearch prefers the former format, therefore we introduce it as a our own posting format here." I think ES prefers the _later_ format?

review_comment: Add a quick note that it was introduced to preserve PFOR space efficiency when Lucene switched back to FOR in 9.9?
